accepted.definition: involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope
accepted.simpleMeaning: Involving or affecting the whole world, not just one country or small area.
accepted.scope: This is not about a round shape, and not about the whole of a single file or set of data; it is only about things that cover the whole world.
examples: Climate change is a global problem.
